linkedIssues.title: Support for short-only flags?
linkedIssues.body:
Hi, sometimes a user may find long flag names crowded or even daunting. Some CLI programs reserve long flag names for advanced or less commonly used features. A user can pick up this hint quickly from the help.

Is there a clean way to define short-only flags? For instance, `-v` without `--version`.

If not, could we have this feature in a future version? Perhaps something like:

```go
Version bool `short:"v" name:"-" help:"show version info and exit"`
```
